6.10 rsChartSeriesPlotTypeIgnored
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsChartSeriesPlotTypeIgnored is a non-critical error that will occur when a ChartSeries.PlotType
element is ignored because the corresponding Chart.Type is not set to "Column".
